## 1218 W George St — Zoning & Development Analysis
**PIN: 14291230290000** | Lake View | Ward 32 (Ald. Waguespack)

---

### (1) Zoning District in Effect

This parcel is zoned **RT-4 (Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse & Multi-Unit)** per the City's official GIS parcel records (ordinance no. 23082T1). [§17-2-0103]

**Verify:** [Chicago Zoning Map](https://gisapps.chicago.gov/ZoningMapWeb/?liab=1&config=zoning) — enter the PIN or address.

**Confidence:** High — this is an authoritative parcel match from Cook County address records.

---

### (2) Is Residential Use Allowed?

**Yes — residential is the primary permitted use.** RT-4 explicitly allows detached houses, two-flats, townhouses, and multi-unit buildings (3+ units), as well as parks, schools, religious institutions, and home occupations. [§17-2-0103]

---

### (3) Key Bulk & Density Standards

| Standard | Value | Source |
|---|---|---|
| **FAR** | 1.2 | [§17-2-0103] |
| **Max height** | 38 ft | [§17-2-0103] |
| **Min lot area per dwelling unit** | 1,000 sq ft | [§17-2-0103] / [1] |
| **Min lot size** | 1,650 sq ft | [§17-2-0103] |
| **Lot coverage** | Not retrieved | — |
| **Setbacks** | Not retrieved | — |

**Unit yield by lot area:** The parcel is 3,075 sq ft ÷ 1,000 sq ft per unit = **3 units** by lot-area math alone. [1] This is a lot-area ceiling only — FAR (1.2 × 3,075 = 3,690 sq ft of buildable floor area), height, parking, and lot configuration may each independently constrain the final unit count further. The existing building is 2,350 sq ft over 2 stories with 3 units, which is already at the lot-area maximum.

**Exemptions that can allow more units:** Ground-floor Type A accessible units are exempt from the lot-area-per-unit count [1]; efficiency and SRO units also count at a reduced area (see the density table at [§17-2-0303]).

**Could not determine:** Specific front, rear, and side setback requirements — these are not in the retrieved code text. Consult [§17-2-0400] directly or contact the Dept. of Planning & Development (DPD).

---

### (4) Overlays & Special Designations

- **Transit-Oriented Development (CTA):** Yes — the parcel is in a CTA TOD area. The nearest CTA rail is Wellington (Brown/Purple Lines), approximately 0.34 miles away.
- **ADU Eligible Area:** Yes [4] — this parcel is in a designated Additional Dwelling Unit area, meaning conversion units (basement/attic/coach house ADUs) may be permitted on the lot under [§17-7-0570] / [4], subject to pre-certification by the Dept. of Housing ([§2-44-106]).
- **Affordable Requirements Ordinance (ARO) Zone:** Yes — the parcel is in an ARO zone. Residential projects triggered by an entitlement (e.g., rezoning, planned development) must provide or fund affordable units. Lake View has 20 ARO-related affordable housing projects totaling 432 units in the community area.
- **Planned Development:** No.
- **Landmark / Historic District:** No — not a Chicago Landmark building, not in a landmark or historic district, not on the National Register.
- **Lakefront Protection Overlay:** No.
- **Special Service Area (SSA):** No.
- **Special District / PMD:** No.
- **Flood Zone:** FEMA Zone X — Area of Minimal Flood Hazard. This is **not** a Special Flood Hazard Area; flood insurance is not federally required.
- **Brownfields:** None nearby.
- **TIF District:** The parcel sits within the **Red and Purple Modernization Phase One Project** TIF district (active 2016–2052) — TIF increment financing may be available for qualifying projects.

---

### (5) Parking Requirement & Transit Relief

Because this parcel is in a **CTA TOD area**, it qualifies for parking minimum reductions under [§17-10-0102-B]. The minimum parking requirement can be reduced **up to 100%** — meaning off-street parking could potentially be eliminated entirely for a qualifying project.

**Important caveat:** RT-4 is not a dash-3 district (e.g., B1-3, B2-3, C1-3), so the transit-served **density/FAR/height bonuses** available in those districts ([§17-3-0402-B]) do **not** apply here. Parking relief is the only transit-related benefit available by right at this zoning classification.

**Could not determine:** The baseline parking minimums (spaces per unit) for RT-4 before the TOD reduction — consult [§17-10-0100] or DPD for the applicable schedule.

---

### (6) Recent Zoning Changes

The current RT-4 classification is tied to ordinance **23082T1**, which the zoning GIS records as the controlling ordinance. This suggests a zoning action occurred under that ordinance number, but the specific date of any reclassification and what the prior zoning was are **not available** in the retrieved data.

**How to verify:** Search the Chicago City Council legislative records at [legistar.cityofchicago.org](https://chicago.legistar.com) using ordinance number 23082T1, or contact DPD's zoning counter at (312) 744-5777.

---
